nytimes_articles.headline: Blameless Above All
nytimes_articles.abstract:
It wasn't my fault! That was my comfort, and I repeated the thought, maybe annoyingly, several times a day. Usually I choose the holiday and get the blame, but that year my wife, Louise, had read about this hotel down in the heel of Italy, aiming in future at the world's playboys and playgirls, but in that first year content with a more modestly heeled clientele. We were willing guinea pigs.

  That, surprisingly, wasn't the problem. What was the problem became apparent as the hotel bus drove up and up, round hairpin bends, over chasms, the roadside decorated with flowers and memorial photographs, both touching and terrifying, of those who had gone over. My wife had not noticed the hotel's altitude in the brochure.

nytimes_articles.headline: Blameless Above All
nytimes_articles.abstract:
It wasn't my fault! That was my comfort, and I repeated the thought, maybe annoyingly, several times a day. Usually I choose the holiday and get the blame, but that year my wife, Louise, had read about this hotel down in the heel of Italy, aiming in future at the world's playboys and playgirls, but in that first year content with a more modestly heeled clientele. We were willing guinea pigs.

  That, surprisingly, wasn't the problem. What was the problem became apparent as the hotel bus drove up and up, round hairpin bends, over chasms, the roadside decorated with flowers and memorial photographs, both touching and terrifying, of those who had gone over. My wife had not noticed the hotel's altitude in the brochure.
